sender.en: A buyer on Facebook Marketplace or Trade Me

name.en: Fake buyer on Marketplace: “I’ll arrange the courier, just click this link”

how.en: You list something for sale on Facebook Marketplace or Trade Me. A “buyer” is in a hurry, says they will arrange the courier and sends a link to a site that looks like NZ Post or a courier company. The site asks for your personal and banking details and a code sent to your phone, and the scammers use them to take money from your account. Other fake buyers send a fake screenshot of a bank transfer so you send the item.

text.en: A buyer wants your item quickly and offers to arrange the courier or pay through a delivery service.
They send a link to a site that looks like NZ Post or a courier company.
The site asks for your card or bank details and a code sent to your phone.
Money is taken from your account, or they send a fake payment screenshot and you lose the item.
Hi is this still available? I will take it for the asking price. I have already paid for NZ Post courier, just click here to confirm your details and receive the payment: [link]

en: A buyer who doesn’t ask questions and wants to arrange the courier themselves.
A link to “receive payment” or “confirm delivery”.
A site that asks for your bank details or a code sent to your phone.
A new profile with few friends or details.
A screenshot of a payment that hasn’t reached your account.
Don’t click links from buyers or sellers, and never enter bank details or codes on them.
Ask for cash on pickup, and don’t send the item until money is in your account.
Never give a code from your bank to anyone.
If you entered details, contact your bank straight away and report the profile to the platform.
